Parameters of scheme switching

Source: R/scheme-switching.R
SchSwchParams.Rd

The parameter object eval_ckks_to_fhew_setup() and eval_scheme_switching_setup() take. SchSwchParams() makes one with the library defaults; the set_ functions on this page change one field each and return the object invisibly, so a parameter object is built step by step as in the OpenFHE examples.

Usage

SchSwchParams(ptr = NULL)

set_security_level_ckks(params, value)

set_security_level_fhew(params, value)

set_arbitrary_function_evaluation(params, value)

set_use_dynamic_mode_fhew(params, value)

set_compute_argmin(params, value)

set_one_hot_encoding(params, value)

set_use_alt_argmin(params, value)

set_num_slots_ckks(params, value)

set_num_values(params, value)

set_ctxt_mod_size_fhew_large_prec(params, value)

set_ctxt_mod_size_fhew_intermed_swch(params, value)

set_b_step_ltr_ckks_to_fhew(params, value)

set_b_step_ltr_fhew_to_ckks(params, value)

set_level_ltr_ckks_to_fhew(params, value)

set_level_ltr_fhew_to_ckks(params, value)

set_ring_dimension(params, value)

set_initial_ckks_modulus(params, value)

set_params_from_ckks_cryptocontext_called(params)

get_security_level_ckks(params)

get_security_level_fhew(params)

get_arbitrary_function_evaluation(params)

get_use_dynamic_mode_fhew(params)

get_compute_argmin(params)

get_one_hot_encoding(params)

get_use_alt_argmin(params)

get_num_slots_ckks(params)

get_num_values(params)

get_ctxt_mod_size_fhew_large_prec(params)

get_ctxt_mod_size_fhew_intermed_swch(params)

get_b_step_ltr_ckks_to_fhew(params)

get_b_step_ltr_fhew_to_ckks(params)

get_level_ltr_ckks_to_fhew(params)

get_level_ltr_fhew_to_ckks(params)

get_ring_dimension(params)

get_initial_ckks_modulus(params)

Arguments

ptr

External pointer (internal use). NULL (default) makes a new parameter object.

params

A SchSwchParams object.

value

The new value of the field: a logical for the five flags, an enum member for the two security levels, a string of decimal digits (or a whole number of at most 2^53) for initial_ckks_modulus, and a non-negative whole number otherwise.

Value

SchSwchParams(): an S7 object of class SchSwchParams, inheriting from OpenFHEObject. The set_ functions: params, invisibly. The get_ functions: the value of the field, a string of decimal digits for initial_ckks_modulus.

Details

The three fields initial_ckks_modulus, ring_dimension, scaling_mod_size and batch_size describe the CKKS context. The setup functions fill them from the context, so they are not set by hand in ordinary use; set_params_from_ckks_cryptocontext() does the same on request.

The get_ functions return the fields. The library refuses to read a parameter object whose CKKS fields have not been filled, so they work after a setup function or set_params_from_ckks_cryptocontext() has been given the object; format() and print() show every field at any time.

FieldMeaningDefault
security_level_ckksSecurity level of the CKKS context, an element of SecurityLevelHEStd_128_classic
security_level_fhewParameter set of the FHEW context, an element of BinFHEParamSetSTD128
arbitrary_function_evaluationWhether the FHEW context is for arbitrary function evaluationFALSE
use_dynamic_mode_fhewWhether the FHEW context uses dynamic gadget basesFALSE
compute_argminWhether the argmin is computed with the minimum (or argmax with the maximum)FALSE
one_hot_encodingWhether the argmin is returned one-hot encodedTRUE
use_alt_argminWhether the alternative argmin method is usedFALSE
num_slots_ckksNumber of CKKS slots to switch0
num_valuesNumber of values to switch0
ctxt_mod_size_fhew_large_precBits of the large-precision FHEW ciphertext modulus25
ctxt_mod_size_fhew_intermed_swchBits of the intermediate modulus of the switch27
b_step_ltr_ckks_to_fhewBaby-step of the linear transform from CKKS to FHEW0
b_step_ltr_fhew_to_ckksBaby-step of the linear transform from FHEW to CKKS0
level_ltr_ckks_to_fhewLevel of the linear transform from CKKS to FHEW1
level_ltr_fhew_to_ckksLevel of the linear transform from FHEW to CKKS0

Examples

params <- SchSwchParams()
set_security_level_ckks(params, SecurityLevel$HEStd_NotSet)
set_security_level_fhew(params, BinFHEParamSet$TOY)
set_num_slots_ckks(params, 16L)
params
#> <SchSwchParams>
#> securityLevelCKKS: HEStd_NotSet; securityLevelFHEW: TOY; numSlotsCKKS: 16; numValues: 0; ctxtModSizeFHEWLargePrec: 25; ctxtModSizeFHEWIntermedSwch: 27; bStepLTrCKKStoFHEW: 0; bStepLTrFHEWtoCKKS: 0; levelLTrCKKStoFHEW: 1; levelLTrFHEWtoCKKS: 0; arbitraryFunctionEvaluation: 0; useDynamicModeFHEW:0; computeArgmin: 0; oneHotEncoding: 1; useAltArgmin: 0; PARAMS SET UP INTERNALLY FROM CRYPTOCONTEXT:  initialCKKSModulus: 0; ringDimension: 0; scalingModSize: 0; batchSize: 0
